answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 7729 Country: India Title: My freind wants to ask that can he marry his Maternal aunt " Khala " if she is marryed to his uncle "Chacha". Question: My freind wants to ask that can he marry his Maternal aunt " Khala " if she is marryed to his uncle "Chacha". Answer ID: 7729 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1030/1030=M/1429) It is unlawful to marry to ones khala (maternal aunt) whether real or sister of mother from her father or mother. Please, clarify if the case is different. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
